easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Displace.
description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Displace, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Displace, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
